title: Hot Water Banana Oats
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Put half a cup of oats in a mug or bowl and pour in enough hot water to cover them.
Cover and wait 5 minutes.
Slice the banana on top and stir.
tips: Add milk or honey if you have them.
doc_text: Hot Water Banana Oats. Ingredients: oats, banana, water, milk, honey. Boil water in the kettle. Slice the banana on top and stir.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Oats
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Pour hot water over the oats in a bowl and cover for 5 minutes.
Mash the banana with a fork and stir it in.
Stir in a spoon of peanut butter.
tips: Peanut butter melts best while the oats are still hot.
doc_text: Peanut Butter Banana Oats. Ingredients: oats, banana, peanut butter, water. Boil water in the kettle. Stir in a spoon of peanut butter.

title: Soaked Oats with Curd
steps: Put the oats in a bowl and mix in the curd.
Let it soak for 10 minutes until soft.
Chop the banana and add it on top.
tips: No heat needed, good for hot days.
doc_text: Soaked Oats with Curd. Ingredients: oats, curd, banana, honey. Put the oats in a bowl and mix in the curd. Chop the banana and add it on top.

title: Savoury Tomato Oats
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Chop the tomato and onion finely and put them in a bowl with the oats and a pinch of salt.
Pour hot water over, cover and wait 5 minutes.
Stir well and eat warm.
tips: Chop the onion very small so it softens in the hot water.
doc_text: Savoury Tomato Oats. Ingredients: oats, tomato, onion, salt, water. Boil water in the kettle. Stir well and eat warm.

title: Kettle Instant Noodles
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Break the noodles into a deep bowl and add the seasoning packet.
Pour boiling water until the noodles are just covered and cover with a plate.
Wait 5 minutes, stir and add chopped onion or tomato if you have them.
tips: Cover the bowl so the noodles cook evenly.
doc_text: Kettle Instant Noodles. Ingredients: instant noodles, water, onion, tomato. Boil water in the kettle. Wait 5 minutes, stir and add chopped onion or tomato if you have them.

title: Crunchy Noodle Salad
steps: Boil water and pour it over the noodles in a bowl; cover for 4 minutes.
Drain the water and let the noodles cool.
Chop the onion, tomato and cucumber.
Mix everything with the seasoning packet and a squeeze of lemon.
tips: Drain well so the salad is not soggy.
doc_text: Crunchy Noodle Salad. Ingredients: instant noodles, onion, tomato, cucumber, lemon, water. Boil water and pour it over the noodles in a bowl; cover for 4 minutes. Mix everything with the seasoning packet and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Hot Water Poha
steps: Rinse the poha in a sieve or bowl and drain.
Boil water in the kettle and pour a little over the poha; cover for 3 minutes.
Chop the onion and tomato and mix them in with salt.
Squeeze lemon on top if you have it.
tips: Use only a little hot water so the poha stays fluffy.
doc_text: Hot Water Poha. Ingredients: poha, onion, tomato, salt, water, lemon. Rinse the poha in a sieve or bowl and drain. Squeeze lemon on top if you have it.

title: Curd Poha
steps: Rinse the poha and drain.
Mix it with curd and salt in a bowl.
Let it soak for 5 minutes and top with chopped onion.
tips: Cool, filling and needs no heat.
doc_text: Curd Poha. Ingredients: poha, curd, salt, onion. Rinse the poha and drain. Let it soak for 5 minutes and top with chopped onion.

title: Banana Poha Bowl
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Pour a little hot water over rinsed poha and cover for 3 minutes.
Slice the banana and stir it in.
Drizzle honey if you have it.
tips: A sweet breakfast version of poha.
doc_text: Banana Poha Bowl. Ingredients: poha, banana, water, honey. Boil water in the kettle. Drizzle honey if you have it.

title: Steeped Tea
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Put the tea in a mug and pour hot water over it.
Steep for 3 minutes and remove the tea.
Add a splash of milk if you like.
tips: Longer steeping makes the tea stronger and more bitter.
doc_text: Steeped Tea. Ingredients: tea, water, milk. Boil water in the kettle. Add a splash of milk if you like.

title: Ginger Lemon Tea
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Chop or crush a small piece of ginger into a mug.
Pour hot water over it and steep for 5 minutes.
Squeeze in lemon and add honey if you have it.
tips: Good for a sore throat.
doc_text: Ginger Lemon Tea. Ingredients: ginger, lemon, water, honey, tea. Boil water in the kettle. Squeeze in lemon and add honey if you have it.

title: Lemon Honey Water
steps: Boil water in the kettle and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Squeeze half a lemon into a mug.
Pour the warm water in and stir in a spoon of honey.
tips: Do not use boiling water on honey, let it cool a little first.
doc_text: Lemon Honey Water. Ingredients: lemon, honey, water. Boil water in the kettle and let it cool for 2 minutes. Pour the warm water in and stir in a spoon of honey.

title: Instant Coffee
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Put a spoon of coffee in a mug.
Pour hot water over it and stir.
Add milk if you have it.
tips: Use half a spoon for a milder cup.
doc_text: Instant Coffee. Ingredients: coffee, water, milk. Boil water in the kettle. Add milk if you have it.

title: Couscous Tomato Bowl
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Put couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pour hot water until just covered.
Cover for 5 minutes then fluff with a fork.
Chop the tomato and onion and mix them in with lemon if you have it.
tips: Use equal parts couscous and water.
doc_text: Couscous Tomato Bowl. Ingredients: couscous, tomato, onion, salt, water, lemon. Boil water in the kettle. Chop the tomato and onion and mix them in with lemon if you have it.

title: Banana Peanut Butter Sandwich
steps: Spread peanut butter on two slices of bread.
Mash the banana with a fork.
Spread the banana on one slice and press the two slices together.
tips: Slice the banana instead of mashing if you like a bit of bite.
doc_text: Banana Peanut Butter Sandwich. Ingredients: bread, banana, peanut butter. Spread peanut butter on two slices of bread. Spread the banana on one slice and press the two slices together.

title: Banana Jam Bread
steps: Spread jam on a slice of bread.
Slice the banana on top.
Cover with a second slice and press.
tips: Works with any fruit jam.
doc_text: Banana Jam Bread. Ingredients: bread, jam, banana. Spread jam on a slice of bread. Cover with a second slice and press.

title: Cucumber Raita
steps: Chop the cucumber into small pieces.
Whisk the curd with a fork and add salt.
Mix in the cucumber and onion.
tips: Chill it for 10 minutes if you can.
doc_text: Cucumber Raita. Ingredients: curd, cucumber, salt, onion. Chop the cucumber into small pieces. Mix in the cucumber and onion.

title: Tomato Onion Salad
steps: Chop the tomato and onion into small pieces.
Add salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Mix and leave for 2 minutes.
tips: Eat with bread for a quick meal.
doc_text: Tomato Onion Salad. Ingredients: tomato, onion, salt, lemon. Chop the tomato and onion into small pieces. Mix and leave for 2 minutes.

title: Chickpea Chaat
steps: Drain a can of chickpeas and rinse them.
Chop the onion and tomato.
Mix everything with salt and lemon juice.
tips: Use ready-to-eat boiled or canned chickpeas.
doc_text: Chickpea Chaat. Ingredients: chickpeas, onion, tomato, lemon, salt. Drain a can of chickpeas and rinse them. Mix everything with salt and lemon juice.

title: Sprouts Salad
steps: Rinse the sprouts well.
Chop the onion and tomato.
Mix with salt and lemon juice.
tips: Buy fresh sprouts and eat them the same day.
doc_text: Sprouts Salad. Ingredients: sprouts, onion, tomato, lemon, salt. Rinse the sprouts well. Mix with salt and lemon juice.

title: Instant Mashed Potato
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Put potato flakes in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Pour in hot water a little at a time, stirring until smooth.
Add milk or butter if you have them.
tips: Add water slowly to avoid lumps.
doc_text: Instant Mashed Potato. Ingredients: potato flakes, water, salt, milk, butter. Boil water in the kettle. Add milk or butter if you have them.

title: Cornflakes Banana Bowl
steps: Pour cornflakes into a bowl.
Slice the banana on top.
Pour cold milk over and eat right away.
tips: Add the milk last to keep the flakes crunchy.
doc_text: Cornflakes Banana Bowl. Ingredients: cornflakes, milk, banana. Pour cornflakes into a bowl. Pour cold milk over and eat right away.

title: Muesli Curd Bowl
steps: Put muesli in a bowl and stir in curd.
Leave for 5 minutes to soften.
Top with sliced banana and honey.
tips: Prepare it the night before for a softer bowl.
doc_text: Muesli Curd Bowl. Ingredients: muesli, curd, banana, honey. Put muesli in a bowl and stir in curd. Top with sliced banana and honey.

title: Chia Milk Pudding
steps: Stir 2 spoons of chia seeds into a glass of milk.
Stir again after 5 minutes to stop clumps.
Let it soak for at least 20 minutes, or overnight.
Top with banana or honey.
tips: Thickens a lot overnight.
doc_text: Chia Milk Pudding. Ingredients: chia seeds, milk, banana, honey. Stir 2 spoons of chia seeds into a glass of milk. Top with banana or honey.

title: Biscuit Banana Mash
steps: Crush the biscuits in a bowl.
Mash the banana and mix it in.
Add a splash of milk and let it soak for 3 minutes.
tips: Any plain biscuit works.
doc_text: Biscuit Banana Mash. Ingredients: biscuits, banana, milk. Crush the biscuits in a bowl. Add a splash of milk and let it soak for 3 minutes.

title: Instant Soup Cup
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Empty the soup sachet into a mug.
Pour in hot water while stirring and wait 2 minutes.
tips: Follow the water amount on the packet.
doc_text: Instant Soup Cup. Ingredients: instant soup, water. Boil water in the kettle. Pour in hot water while stirring and wait 2 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Mix cocoa powder and milk powder in a mug.
Pour in hot water slowly while stirring.
Sweeten with honey if you like.
tips: Make a paste with a little water first to avoid lumps.
doc_text: Hot Chocolate. Ingredients: cocoa powder, milk powder, water, honey. Boil water in the kettle. Sweeten with honey if you like.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Shake
steps: Mash the banana very well in a big glass.
Add a spoon of peanut butter and a little milk and stir into a paste.
Pour in the rest of the milk and stir well.
tips: A shaker bottle helps.
doc_text: Peanut Butter Banana Shake. Ingredients: peanut butter, banana, milk. Mash the banana very well in a big glass. Pour in the rest of the milk and stir well.

title: Rice Noodle Veg Salad
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Put the thin rice noodles in a bowl and pour hot water over; cover for 5 minutes.
Drain and rinse with cold water.
Chop the carrot and cucumber and mix with salt and lemon.
tips: Thin rice noodles soften in hot water without cooking.
doc_text: Rice Noodle Veg Salad. Ingredients: rice noodles, carrot, cucumber, lemon, salt, water. Boil water in the kettle. Chop the carrot and cucumber and mix with salt and lemon.

title: Instant Upma Cup
steps: Boil water in the kettle.
Empty the upma mix into a bowl.
Pour in hot water as per the packet and stir.
Cover for 3 minutes and top with chopped onion.
tips: Stir once more before eating.
doc_text: Instant Upma Cup. Ingredients: upma mix, water, onion. Boil water in the kettle. Cover for 3 minutes and top with chopped onion.

title: Boiled Egg Salad
steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with water and boil for 10 minutes.
Cool the eggs in cold water and peel them.
Chop the eggs, onion and tomato.
Mix with salt.
tips: Eggs must be hard-boiled all the way through.
doc_text: Boiled Egg Salad. Ingredients: egg, onion, tomato, salt, water. Put the eggs in a pot, cover with water and boil for 10 minutes. Mix with salt.

title: Egg Tomato Curry
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel.
Chop the onion and tomato and cook them in a pot with a little water (or oil) until soft.
Add salt and half a cup of water and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer 3 more minutes.
tips: Prick the eggs with a fork so the gravy gets inside.
doc_text: Egg Tomato Curry. Ingredients: egg, tomato, onion, salt, water, oil. Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Add the eggs and simmer 3 more minutes.

title: Boiled Potato Mash Bowl
steps: Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil in salted water for 15 minutes.
Drain and mash with a fork.
Mix in chopped onion and butter if you have it.
tips: Poke with a knife to check they are soft.
doc_text: Boiled Potato Mash Bowl. Ingredients: potato, onion, salt, water, butter. Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil in salted water for 15 minutes. Mix in chopped onion and butter if you have it.

title: Masala Noodles Pot
steps: Chop the onion and tomato.
Boil two cups of water in a pot and add the onion and tomato for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and the seasoning packet and cook 3 minutes, stirring.
tips: Use less water for drier noodles.
doc_text: Masala Noodles Pot. Ingredients: instant noodles, onion, tomato, water. Chop the onion and tomato. Add the noodles and the seasoning packet and cook 3 minutes, stirring.

title: Egg Noodles Pot
steps: Boil two cups of water in a pot and add the noodles.
After 2 minutes add the seasoning packet.
Crack in the egg and stir for 2 minutes until fully cooked.
tips: Make sure the egg is cooked through with no runny parts.
doc_text: Egg Noodles Pot. Ingredients: instant noodles, egg, water. Boil two cups of water in a pot and add the noodles. Crack in the egg and stir for 2 minutes until fully cooked.

title: Simple Khichdi
steps: Wash half a cup each of rice and lentils.
Put them in a pot with 3 cups water, salt and turmeric.
Boil, then simmer covered for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add a little water if it gets too thick.
tips: Comfort food for a sick day.
doc_text: Simple Khichdi. Ingredients: rice, lentils, salt, water, turmeric. Wash half a cup each of rice and lentils. Add a little water if it gets too thick.

title: Dal Rice Bowl with Onion
steps: Boil lentils with 3 cups water and salt for 20 minutes until soft.
In another pot boil rice with water for 15 minutes.
Fry-free: stir chopped raw onion into the dal.
Serve dal over the rice.
tips: Mash the dal with a spoon for a smoother texture.
doc_text: Dal Rice Bowl with Onion. Ingredients: rice, lentils, onion, salt, water. Boil lentils with 3 cups water and salt for 20 minutes until soft. Serve dal over the rice.

title: Tomato Dal Soup
steps: Wash the lentils and boil them with 3 cups water and salt for 15 minutes.
Add chopped tomato and onion and simmer 10 more minutes.
Mash lightly with a spoon.
tips: Thin with water to make it a soup.
doc_text: Tomato Dal Soup. Ingredients: lentils, tomato, onion, salt, water. Wash the lentils and boil them with 3 cups water and salt for 15 minutes. Mash lightly with a spoon.

title: Tomato Onion Soup
steps: Chop the tomato and onion.
Simmer them in 2 cups of water with salt for 12 minutes.
Mash well with a spoon or fork and add pepper.
tips: Strain for a smooth soup.
doc_text: Tomato Onion Soup. Ingredients: tomato, onion, salt, water, black pepper. Chop the tomato and onion. Mash well with a spoon or fork and add pepper.

title: Egg Fried Rice Pan
steps: Boil the rice in plenty of water for 12 minutes and drain.
Chop the onion and cook it in the pan (with oil if you have it) for 2 minutes.
Push to the side, scramble the egg until fully cooked and mix with the rice and salt.
tips: Cold leftover rice works even better.
doc_text: Egg Fried Rice Pan. Ingredients: rice, egg, onion, salt, water, oil. Boil the rice in plenty of water for 12 minutes and drain. Push to the side, scramble the egg until fully cooked and mix with the rice and salt.

title: Poha Pan Mix
steps: Rinse the poha and drain.
Chop the onion and potato small and cook the potato in a pan with a splash of water until soft.
Add onion and peanuts and cook for 2 minutes.
Add poha and salt and stir for 2 minutes.
tips: Keep the heat medium so nothing burns without oil.
doc_text: Poha Pan Mix. Ingredients: poha, onion, potato, peanuts, salt, oil. Rinse the poha and drain. Add poha and salt and stir for 2 minutes.

title: Milk Banana Oats
steps: Pour a cup of milk into a pot and bring it to a gentle boil.
Add half a cup of oats and simmer 4 minutes, stirring.
Top with sliced banana.
tips: Stir constantly so the milk does not catch.
doc_text: Milk Banana Oats. Ingredients: oats, milk, banana. Pour a cup of milk into a pot and bring it to a gentle boil. Top with sliced banana.

title: Stove Masala Tea
steps: Boil one cup of water in a pot and add the tea.
Add half a cup of milk and simmer 3 minutes.
Strain into a cup and add sugar if you like.
tips: Watch the pot, milk boils over fast.
doc_text: Stove Masala Tea. Ingredients: tea, milk, water, sugar. Boil one cup of water in a pot and add the tea. Strain into a cup and add sugar if you like.

title: Pan Cheese Toast
steps: Place the cheese on a slice of bread and cover with another slice.
Toast in a dry pan on low heat for 2 minutes per side.
Press down gently until the cheese melts.
tips: Cover the pan to melt the cheese faster.
doc_text: Pan Cheese Toast. Ingredients: bread, cheese. Place the cheese on a slice of bread and cover with another slice. Press down gently until the cheese melts.

title: Simple Tomato Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water for 10 minutes and drain, saving a cup of the water.
Cook chopped onion and tomato in the pot with a splash of pasta water for 8 minutes.
Mash the tomato, add the pasta and mix.
tips: Pasta water makes the sauce stick better.
doc_text: Simple Tomato Pasta. Ingredients: pasta, tomato, onion, salt, water, oil. Boil pasta in salted water for 10 minutes and drain, saving a cup of the water. Mash the tomato, add the pasta and mix.

title: Corn Onion Chaat
steps: Boil the corn in water for 8 minutes and drain.
Chop the onion finely.
Mix with salt and lemon juice.
tips: Use frozen or canned corn for speed.
doc_text: Corn Onion Chaat. Ingredients: corn, onion, lemon, salt, water. Boil the corn in water for 8 minutes and drain. Mix with salt and lemon juice.

title: Boiled Sweet Potato
steps: Wash and cut the sweet potato into chunks.
Boil in water for 15 to 20 minutes until soft.
Peel if you wish and sprinkle with salt.
tips: Test with a knife, it should slide in easily.
doc_text: Boiled Sweet Potato. Ingredients: sweet potato, salt, water. Wash and cut the sweet potato into chunks. Peel if you wish and sprinkle with salt.

title: Chickpea Tomato Masala
steps: Chop the onion and tomato.
Simmer them in half a cup of water with salt until soft, about 8 minutes.
Mash the tomato, add drained chickpeas and simmer 8 more minutes.
tips: Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
doc_text: Chickpea Tomato Masala. Ingredients: chickpeas, tomato, onion, salt, water. Chop the onion and tomato. Mash the tomato, add drained chickpeas and simmer 8 more minutes.

title: Paneer Onion Bhurji
steps: Chop the onion and tomato; crumble the paneer.
Cook onion and tomato in a pan with a splash of water (or oil) until soft.
Add paneer and salt and cook 3 minutes.
tips: Do not overcook or the paneer turns rubbery.
doc_text: Paneer Onion Bhurji. Ingredients: paneer, onion, tomato, salt, oil. Chop the onion and tomato; crumble the paneer. Add paneer and salt and cook 3 minutes.

title: Egg Rice Porridge
steps: Boil half a cup of rice in 4 cups of water with salt for 25 minutes until very soft.
Crack in the egg and stir quickly for 2 minutes until fully cooked.
tips: Great for an upset stomach.
doc_text: Egg Rice Porridge. Ingredients: rice, egg, salt, water. Boil half a cup of rice in 4 cups of water with salt for 25 minutes until very soft. Crack in the egg and stir quickly for 2 minutes until fully cooked.

title: Pan French Toast
steps: Whisk the egg and milk in a plate.
Dip each bread slice on both sides.
Cook in a pan (with a little butter if you have it) until golden on both sides and the egg is set.
tips: Use stale bread for best results.
doc_text: Pan French Toast. Ingredients: bread, egg, milk, butter. Whisk the egg and milk in a plate. Cook in a pan (with a little butter if you have it) until golden on both sides and the egg is set.

title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Chop the carrot, potato and onion small.
Boil them in 3 cups of water with salt for 20 minutes.
Mash a few pieces to thicken the soup.
tips: Smaller pieces cook faster.
doc_text: Vegetable Soup. Ingredients: carrot, potato, onion, salt, water. Chop the carrot, potato and onion small. Mash a few pieces to thicken the soup.

title: Banana Egg Pancakes
steps: Mash one banana until smooth.
Mix in one egg until combined.
Cook spoonfuls in a pan on low heat for 2 minutes per side until set.
tips: Keep them small so they flip easily.
doc_text: Banana Egg Pancakes. Ingredients: banana, egg, butter. Mash one banana until smooth. Cook spoonfuls in a pan on low heat for 2 minutes per side until set.

title: Egg Bhurji Pan
steps: Chop the onion and tomato and cook them in a pan until soft.
Beat the eggs with salt and pour them in.
Stir until the eggs are fully cooked and dry.
tips: Cooked through means no runny egg left.
doc_text: Egg Bhurji Pan. Ingredients: egg, onion, tomato, salt, oil, butter. Chop the onion and tomato and cook them in a pan until soft. Stir until the eggs are fully cooked and dry.

title: Baked Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Wash the potato, prick it with a fork and rub with salt.
Bake 45 minutes until soft inside.
Cut open and add butter if you have it.
tips: Wrap in foil for softer skin.
doc_text: Baked Potato. Ingredients: potato, salt, butter. Heat the oven to 200 C. Cut open and add butter if you have it.

title: Baked Banana with Peanut Butter
steps: Heat the oven to 180 C.
Slit the banana lengthwise without peeling and bake 10 minutes.
Open and fill with peanut butter.
tips: The peel turns dark, that is normal.
doc_text: Baked Banana with Peanut Butter. Ingredients: banana, peanut butter. Heat the oven to 180 C. Open and fill with peanut butter.

title: Oven Cheese Toast
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Top the bread with cheese and tomato slices.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes until the cheese bubbles.
tips: Watch it, the top browns fast.
doc_text: Oven Cheese Toast. Ingredients: bread, cheese, tomato. Heat the oven to 200 C. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes until the cheese bubbles.

title: Baked Egg in Tomato
steps: Heat the oven to 190 C.
Chop tomato and onion and spread them in a small dish with salt.
Crack the egg on top.
Bake 15 minutes until the egg is fully set.
tips: Do not eat if the egg white is still clear.
doc_text: Baked Egg in Tomato. Ingredients: egg, tomato, onion, salt. Heat the oven to 190 C. Bake 15 minutes until the egg is fully set.

title: Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Drain and dry the chickpeas very well, then mix with salt on a tray.
Roast 25 minutes, shaking once, until crunchy.
tips: Dry chickpeas get crunchier.
doc_text: Roasted Chickpeas. Ingredients: chickpeas, salt. Heat the oven to 200 C. Roast 25 minutes, shaking once, until crunchy.

title: Baked Sweet Potato
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Prick the sweet potato with a fork and bake 40 minutes until soft.
Cut open, add salt and butter if you like.
tips: Place a tray under it to catch sticky drips.
doc_text: Baked Sweet Potato. Ingredients: sweet potato, salt, butter. Heat the oven to 200 C. Cut open, add salt and butter if you like.

title: Aloo Jeera
steps: Boil the potatoes until just soft, peel and cube them.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin until it sizzles.
Add potato, turmeric and salt and fry 5 minutes until golden.
tips: Boil whole potatoes and cool them for cleaner cubes.
doc_text: Aloo Jeera. Ingredients: potato, cumin, turmeric, oil, salt, water. Boil the potatoes until just soft, peel and cube them. Add potato, turmeric and salt and fry 5 minutes until golden.

title: Egg Curry
steps: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel them.
Heat oil and cook chopped onion until golden, then add tomato.
Add turmeric, chili powder, salt and a cup of water; simmer 8 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer 3 minutes.
tips: Slit the eggs lightly so the gravy soaks in.
doc_text: Egg Curry. Ingredients: egg, onion, tomato, oil, turmeric, chili powder, salt, water. Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel them. Add the eggs and simmer 3 minutes.

title: Dal Tadka
steps: Boil lentils with turmeric, salt and 3 cups water for 20 minutes until soft.
Heat oil, add cumin, then chopped onion and tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Pour this tadka over the dal and mix.
tips: Use a pressure cooker if you have one.
doc_text: Dal Tadka. Ingredients: lentils, onion, tomato, oil, cumin, turmeric, salt, water. Boil lentils with turmeric, salt and 3 cups water for 20 minutes until soft. Pour this tadka over the dal and mix.

title: Jeera Rice
steps: Wash the rice and soak 10 minutes.
Heat oil, add cumin until it sizzles, then add the rice and stir 1 minute.
Add 2 cups water and salt, cover and cook 12 minutes on low.
tips: Do not lift the lid while cooking.
doc_text: Jeera Rice. Ingredients: rice, cumin, oil, salt, water. Wash the rice and soak 10 minutes. Add 2 cups water and salt, cover and cook 12 minutes on low.

title: Veg Pulao
steps: Heat oil, add cumin and sliced onion and cook until soft.
Add peas, chopped carrot and washed rice and stir 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups water and salt, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
tips: Use frozen peas to save time.
doc_text: Veg Pulao. Ingredients: rice, peas, carrot, onion, oil, cumin, salt, water. Heat oil, add cumin and sliced onion and cook until soft. Add 2 cups water and salt, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.

title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Boil, peel and mash the potatoes; mix with salt and chili powder.
Knead flour with water and a pinch of salt into soft dough.
Roll a ball, stuff with potato, seal and roll flat.
Cook on a hot pan with oil until golden on both sides.
tips: Do not overfill or it will tear.
doc_text: Aloo Paratha. Ingredients: wheat flour, potato, oil, salt, chili powder, water. Boil, peel and mash the potatoes; mix with salt and chili powder. Cook on a hot pan with oil until golden on both sides.

title: Masala Omelette
steps: Chop the onion and tomato finely.
Beat the eggs with salt, chili powder and the veggies.
Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook until set, flipping once.
tips: Cook it fully, no runny egg.
doc_text: Masala Omelette. Ingredients: egg, onion, tomato, oil, salt, chili powder. Chop the onion and tomato finely. Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook until set, flipping once.

title: Bread Omelette
steps: Beat the egg with salt and chopped onion.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in the egg.
Place a bread slice on top, flip and cook until the egg is set.
tips: Press the bread gently so it sticks.
doc_text: Bread Omelette. Ingredients: bread, egg, onion, oil, salt. Beat the egg with salt and chopped onion. Place a bread slice on top, flip and cook until the egg is set.

title: Tadka Poha
steps: Rinse the poha and drain.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and peanuts, then chopped potato and onion.
Cook until soft, add turmeric and salt, then the poha.
Mix gently for 2 minutes.
tips: Add lemon at the end if you have it.
doc_text: Tadka Poha. Ingredients: poha, onion, potato, peanuts, mustard seeds, turmeric, oil, salt. Rinse the poha and drain. Mix gently for 2 minutes.

title: Veg Maggi Masala
steps: Heat oil and cook chopped onion and tomato with chili powder for 3 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and seasoning and cook 3 minutes.
tips: Less water gives a thicker masala.
doc_text: Veg Maggi Masala. Ingredients: instant noodles, onion, tomato, oil, chili powder. Heat oil and cook chopped onion and tomato with chili powder for 3 minutes. Add the noodles and seasoning and cook 3 minutes.

title: Veg Fried Rice
steps: Boil rice, drain and let it cool.
Heat oil on high, cook chopped onion, carrot and peas for 3 minutes.
Add rice, soy sauce and salt and toss 3 minutes.
tips: Day-old rice fries best.
doc_text: Veg Fried Rice. Ingredients: rice, carrot, peas, onion, oil, soy sauce, salt, water. Boil rice, drain and let it cool. Add rice, soy sauce and salt and toss 3 minutes.

title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the egg and milk.
Stir in flour and sugar into a thick batter.
Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan until golden on both sides.
tips: Rest the batter 5 minutes.
doc_text: Banana Pancakes. Ingredients: wheat flour, banana, milk, egg, butter, sugar. Mash the banana and mix with the egg and milk. Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan until golden on both sides.

title: Microwave Mug Cake
steps: Mix 4 spoons flour, 2 spoons cocoa and 3 spoons sugar in a mug.
Add 3 spoons milk and 2 spoons oil and stir smooth.
Microwave 90 seconds. Let it cool before eating.
tips: Use a big mug, it rises.
doc_text: Microwave Mug Cake. Ingredients: wheat flour, cocoa powder, milk, sugar, oil. Mix 4 spoons flour, 2 spoons cocoa and 3 spoons sugar in a mug. Microwave 90 seconds. Let it cool before eating.

title: Microwave Mug Omelette
steps: Grease a mug with butter.
Beat egg, milk, salt and chopped veg in the mug.
Microwave 1 minute, stir, then 30 to 60 more seconds until fully set.
tips: Stop and stir midway for even cooking.
doc_text: Microwave Mug Omelette. Ingredients: egg, milk, onion, tomato, salt, butter. Grease a mug with butter. Microwave 1 minute, stir, then 30 to 60 more seconds until fully set.

title: Microwave Oats Bowl
steps: Put oats and milk in a large microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave 2 minutes, stir.
Top with sliced banana and sugar.
tips: The bowl should be double the size of the mixture.
doc_text: Microwave Oats Bowl. Ingredients: oats, milk, banana, sugar. Put oats and milk in a large microwave-safe bowl. Top with sliced banana and sugar.

title: Microwave Baked Potato
steps: Prick the potato all over with a fork.
Microwave 5 minutes, flip, then 3 to 4 more minutes until soft.
Cut open and add butter, salt and pepper.
tips: Let it sit 2 minutes, it is very hot inside.
doc_text: Microwave Baked Potato. Ingredients: potato, butter, salt, black pepper. Prick the potato all over with a fork. Cut open and add butter, salt and pepper.

title: Microwave Scrambled Eggs
steps: Beat eggs with milk and salt in a bowl with butter.
Microwave 45 seconds, stir.
Microwave 30 to 45 more seconds until fully set; add pepper.
tips: Eggs must be solid with no liquid left.
doc_text: Microwave Scrambled Eggs. Ingredients: egg, milk, butter, salt, black pepper. Beat eggs with milk and salt in a bowl with butter. Microwave 30 to 45 more seconds until fully set; add pepper.

title: Microwave Veg Upma
steps: Mix oil and mustard seeds in a bowl and microwave 1 minute.
Add chopped onion, carrot and semolina and microwave 2 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups hot water and salt, stir, and microwave 4 minutes.
tips: Stir halfway through.
doc_text: Microwave Veg Upma. Ingredients: semolina, onion, carrot, oil, mustard seeds, salt, water. Mix oil and mustard seeds in a bowl and microwave 1 minute. Add 1.5 cups hot water and salt, stir, and microwave 4 minutes.

title: Chana Masala
steps: Heat oil, add cumin, then chopped onion and cook until golden.
Add tomato, chili powder and garam masala and cook till soft.
Add drained chickpeas, salt and a cup of water; simmer 12 minutes.
tips: Mash a few chickpeas to thicken.
doc_text: Chana Masala. Ingredients: chickpeas, onion, tomato, oil, cumin, garam masala, chili powder, salt, water. Heat oil, add cumin, then chopped onion and cook until golden. Add drained chickpeas, salt and a cup of water; simmer 12 minutes.

title: Rajma Masala
steps: Use canned or boiled kidney beans, drained.
Cook chopped onion and tomato in oil with spices until soft.
Add the beans and water, simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few.
tips: Best with rice.
doc_text: Rajma Masala. Ingredients: kidney beans, onion, tomato, oil, garam masala, chili powder, salt, water. Use canned or boiled kidney beans, drained. Add the beans and water, simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few.

title: Aloo Gobi
steps: Chop the potato and cauliflower into small pieces.
Cook chopped onion and tomato in oil with turmeric and chili powder.
Add the vegetables and salt, cover and cook 20 minutes, stirring.
tips: Add a splash of water if it sticks.
doc_text: Aloo Gobi. Ingredients: potato, cauliflower, onion, tomato, oil, turmeric, chili powder, salt. Chop the potato and cauliflower into small pieces. Add the vegetables and salt, cover and cook 20 minutes, stirring.

title: Bhindi Fry
steps: Wash the okra, dry completely and slice.
Heat oil and fry the onion for 2 minutes.
Add okra, turmeric, chili powder and salt and fry 10 minutes without a lid.
tips: Dry okra stays less slimy.
doc_text: Bhindi Fry. Ingredients: okra, onion, oil, turmeric, chili powder, salt. Wash the okra, dry completely and slice. Add okra, turmeric, chili powder and salt and fry 10 minutes without a lid.

title: Curd Rice Tadka
steps: Boil rice until very soft and let it cool.
Mix with curd and salt.
Heat oil, pop the mustard seeds and pour over the rice.
tips: Add a little milk if it gets dry.
doc_text: Curd Rice Tadka. Ingredients: rice, curd, mustard seeds, oil, salt, water. Boil rice until very soft and let it cool. Heat oil, pop the mustard seeds and pour over the rice.

title: Sooji Halwa
steps: Roast the semolina in ghee on low heat until golden.
Add a cup of warm milk and water with sugar, stirring.
Cook until thick and the ghee separates.
tips: Stir all the time to avoid lumps.
doc_text: Sooji Halwa. Ingredients: semolina, ghee, sugar, milk, water. Roast the semolina in ghee on low heat until golden. Cook until thick and the ghee separates.

title: Besan Chilla
steps: Mix gram flour, water, turmeric, chili powder and salt into a thin batter.
Add chopped onion and tomato.
Spread on a hot oiled pan and cook both sides until golden.
tips: The batter should be pourable like thin yogurt.
doc_text: Besan Chilla. Ingredients: gram flour, onion, tomato, oil, turmeric, chili powder, salt, water. Mix gram flour, water, turmeric, chili powder and salt into a thin batter. Spread on a hot oiled pan and cook both sides until golden.

title: Veg Grilled Sandwich
steps: Butter the bread slices.
Fill with sliced tomato, onion and cheese.
Toast in a pan on low heat until golden and the cheese melts.
tips: Press with a spatula as it toasts.
doc_text: Veg Grilled Sandwich. Ingredients: bread, tomato, onion, cheese, butter. Butter the bread slices. Toast in a pan on low heat until golden and the cheese melts.

title: Rice Kheer
steps: Wash a handful of rice.
Simmer it in 2 cups of milk on low heat for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Add sugar and cook 5 more minutes.
tips: Stir often so the milk does not stick.
doc_text: Rice Kheer. Ingredients: rice, milk, sugar. Wash a handful of rice. Add sugar and cook 5 more minutes.

title: Paneer Masala
steps: Cook chopped onion in oil until golden, then add tomato and spices.
Cook until soft, add half a cup of water and salt.
Add cubed paneer and simmer 5 minutes.
tips: Soak paneer in warm water to keep it soft.
doc_text: Paneer Masala. Ingredients: paneer, onion, tomato, oil, garam masala, chili powder, turmeric, salt, water. Cook chopped onion in oil until golden, then add tomato and spices. Add cubed paneer and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Spinach Dal
steps: Boil lentils with turmeric, salt and water for 20 minutes.
Add chopped spinach and cook 3 minutes.
Heat oil, cook cumin and chopped onion, then stir into the dal.
tips: Spinach cooks down a lot, use a big handful.
doc_text: Spinach Dal. Ingredients: lentils, spinach, onion, oil, cumin, turmeric, salt, water. Boil lentils with turmeric, salt and water for 20 minutes. Heat oil, cook cumin and chopped onion, then stir into the dal.

title: Tomato Rasam
steps: Boil lentils with turmeric until soft and mash.
Simmer chopped tomato with salt and 2 cups of water for 10 minutes.
Mix in the dal and pepper and bring to a gentle boil.
Heat oil, pop mustard seeds and cumin and pour over.
tips: Drink it as a soup or pour over rice.
doc_text: Tomato Rasam. Ingredients: tomato, lentils, cumin, black pepper, oil, mustard seeds, turmeric, salt, water. Boil lentils with turmeric until soft and mash. Heat oil, pop mustard seeds and cumin and pour over.
